# BE3

## About

Why should every app need to reinvent live collaborative editing, permissions, accounts, undo/redo, rich text editing, teams, ...etc?

BE3 aims to solve this.

## Development

See guides/buck2.md for detailed instructions

```
# run app
./scripts/buck run //crates/block-app:app

# test app
./scripts/verify

# run for web
./scripts/buck run //crates/block-app:web-serve

# run for android
./scripts/buck run //crates/block-app:android -- --install

# run beui's demo
./scripts/buck run //crates/beui-demo:demo

# run be-compositor
./scripts/buck run //crates/be-compositor:be-compositor-bin
```
